title: Suchomimus: Complete Overview

description: Suchomimus ("crocodile mimic") was a piscivore dinosaur of the Early Cretaceous (125-112 million years ago), reaching about 11 m. Spinosaurus relative; sail-backed fish hunter. # Suchomimus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Suchomimus mean?", "crocodile mimic"),

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

        print("Correct.")

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
